title: `resolve_dependency_groups` reports only the first broken included group
spec:
This is the `packaging` library (Python 3, no dependencies; the code is in `src/packaging/`). Run the tests with `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests --ignore=tests/property` (about a minute).

`resolve_dependency_groups` is meant to collect every error in one go, but it stops reporting after the first included group that fails to parse.

```python
from packaging.dependency_groups import resolve_dependency_groups
groups = {
    "root": [{"include-group": "bad"}, {"include-group": "wrapper"}],
    "bad": ["!!! bad invalid"],
    "wrapper": [{"include-group": "also-bad"}],
    "also-bad": ["!!! also invalid"],
}
resolve_dependency_groups(groups, "root")
```
Expected: an `ExceptionGroup` with two `InvalidRequirement`s, first for `!!! bad invalid`, then for `!!! also invalid`, so I can fix everything in one pass.
Actual: the group holds only the `!!! bad invalid` error; `also-bad` is never reported.

Similar inputs are probably affected too; please fix the underlying problem rather than just this case.
acceptance: the reported example produces the expected output
the underlying problem is fixed, not just the reported input
